title: DHA Policy for Health Data and Information Sharing (DHA/HISHD/PP-13), English
notes: DHA-published English version, 39 pages, issued 10 August 2024, revision due August 2029; applies to healthcare entities under DHA jurisdiction. Section 4.6.5 lists care-purpose sharing settings, including patients treated outside the UAE and samples sent to laboratories outside the UAE (patient consent needed); these are not presented as the full Resolution No. 51 list. Section 4.7.5 lists secondary uses without consent; scientific and clinical research is allowed for non-identifiable data if ICH-GCP ethics and rules are followed, with patient consent required for identifiable data. Checked on the rendered page (p. 18): the condition cell is merged across the research row and the row 'For development and innovation activities or health registries', so the same condition applies to both; text extraction shows it after the research row only. Section 4.20 repeats PP-11: transfers outside the UAE only under the Resolution No. 51 exemptions (called a 'Cabinet Decision') plus DHA approval. Breach notifications go to the 'UAE Information Office' and DHA (4.23). Arabic version not registered.

title: MDCG 2020-3 Rev.1 Guidance on significant changes regarding the transitional provision under Article 120 of the MDR
notes: 21 pages, May 2023. Endorsed by the MDCG; states it is not a European Commission document and not legally binding. Scope is limited to legacy devices still covered by MDD/AIMDD certificates under the MDR Article 120 transition; it does not govern changes to devices certified under the MDR (those follow MDR Annex IX 4.10). Contains a software change flowchart. Whether Swissmedic applies MDCG guidance is not established in this knowledge base. Placed in the GLOBAL pack with the EU MDR.
